thread:
Maria K.: quick heads-up — ran onboarding smoke + profiling for centaur-7B on a 2xA10G pool this morning. uploading raw logs + a short summary. will call out anything odd.

Evan L.: nice, can you capture peak GPU memory, tokens/sec, and p95/p99 latencies? also include KV-cache hit rate if possible.

Maria K.: yes — grabbing memory + perf counters. ran two configs: default fp16 and q4f16. warmup 20 iters, then 120 iters sampling. command:```
perf-run --model centaur-7b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --warmup 20 --iters 120 --profile gpu,kv
```

Shweta R.: thanks — did you enable continuous batching? that changes p50 a bit for smaller batches.

Maria K.: no continuous batching for this run (we wanted strict single-request latencies). I can re-run with batching after folks review these baseline numbers.

Tobias: pinging benchbot to publish aggregate numbers and upload to GCS. cc @eng-oncall if anything crosses the failure thresholds.

benchbot: Published summary -> gs://redwood-inference/bench/centaur-7b/1829123456/summary.json ; artifacts -> gs://redwood-inference/bench/centaur-7b/1829123456/artifacts.tar.gz 

Maria K.: paste of key numbers from summary:
- config: 2x A10G, single-request mode, seq=1024, batch=1 effective
- fp16: p50=26.8ms, p95=108.6ms, p99=243.4ms, tokens/sec=915, gpu_mem_peak=36.9GB, kv_cache_hit=91.8%
- q4f16: p50=29.5ms, p95=119.2ms, p99=270.7ms, tokens/sec=870, gpu_mem_peak=27.3GB, kv_cache_hit=91.2%
- 99th tail shows a small bump when background GC kicked in at ~iter 88 (see log).

Evan L.: those tail numbers look reasonable. memory drop on q4f16 is good. can you attach the flamegraph or nvprof snapshot path?

Maria K.: flamegraph in artifacts: artifacts/profiles/flame-1829123456.html. nvprof snapshot -> artifacts/profiles/nvprof-iter88.log. GC was a sporadic Python memory compact; appears unrelated to CUDA allocations.

Shweta R.: did you test a canary with kv-cache warm path (prefix caching)? pkt hit rate 91% looks good but sometimes seq=256 flows are different.

Maria K.: not yet. I'll run a short seq=256 prefix-warm run after lunch and post results (likely higher throughput, lower p50).

Tobias: can we mark this model as "smoke-passed" for onboarding? any regression vs our baseline Llama-3-ish 7B targets?

Evan L.: delta vs our 7B baseline: p95 within +5–10% for fp16, q4f16 saves ~9–10GB memory but adds ~8–12% tail. overall acceptable for Dedicated config. I'm +1 for smoke-pass.

Maria K.: marking thread: smoke-pass. filing a short onboarding ticket and PR: #4523 (centaur-7b: onboarding docs + perf profile). link to PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4523 

Shweta R.: thanks Maria. once you do seq=256 prefix-warm, please sanity-check autoregressive output for degeneration (quick eval set).

Maria K.: will do. re-run scheduled ~13:30 PT, I'll post quick diff and any follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Evan L.: great. if anything spikes on p99 during the warm-run, add a note and notify @eng-oncall. otherwise we can push the model to the catalog canary lane.

Tobias: noted. thanks team.
